strings.zh: 桧皮镇的道馆原本是由{NEWLINE}岩铁先生的家族世代继承的。{CLEAR}但是到了岩铁先生这一代,{CLEAR}岩铁先生痴迷于制作柑果球,{CLEAR}加上精灵联盟取消了馆主世袭,{CLEAR}于是桧皮道馆的主人就换成了{CLEAR}年轻的精英训练家阿笔。
strings.en: Azalea’s Gym used to be passed{NEWLINE}down through Mr. Kurt’s family for{CLEAR}generations. But Mr. Kurt got obsessed{CLEAR}with making Apricorn Balls, and on top{CLEAR}of that the Pokémon League abolished{CLEAR}hereditary Gym Leaders. So the Azalea{CLEAR}Gym went to a young Ace Trainer, Bugsy.

strings.zh: 别看大妈我这样,{NEWLINE}我可是追星一族哦！{CLEAR}我会收集帅气训练家们的{CLEAR}海报、手办、明信片之类的东西。{CLEAR}在我心目中全地区最帅的训练家{CLEAR}是常磐道馆的馆主小绿,{CLEAR}排名第二的是四天王阿渡,{CLEAR}排名第三的是桔梗道馆的阿速。
strings.en: I may not look it, but this auntie is a{NEWLINE}big fangirl! I collect posters, figures,{CLEAR}postcards and all that stuff of{CLEAR}handsome Trainers. In my heart, the{CLEAR}most handsome Trainer in the whole{CLEAR}region is Blue, the Viridian Gym Leader.{CLEAR}Second is Lance of the Elite Four, and{CLEAR}third is Falkner of the Violet Gym.
strings.notes: 大妈 → ‘this auntie’ (self-reference). | RV033: meaning: 全地区 = the whole region, not all regions (D-1870)

strings.zh: 有人说在河里能钓到呆呆兽,{NEWLINE}但是呆呆兽的体重可有几十千克,{CLEAR}如果是一般人用一般的钓竿,{CLEAR}肯定是钓不起呆呆兽的吧？
strings.en: Some people say you can fish Slowpoke{NEWLINE}out of the river. But a Slowpoke{CLEAR}weighs dozens of kilograms. An{CLEAR}ordinary person with an ordinary{CLEAR}rod could never reel one in, right?

strings.zh: 那你觉得联盟冠军帅吗？

strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: So, do you think League{NEWLINE}Champion {VAR:0101:0} is handsome?

strings.zh: 哎呀,{VAR:0103:0}那个孩子啊太低调,{NEWLINE}推出的周边太少了,{CLEAR}就我看石英大会的录像来说{CLEAR}他的实力虽然是最强的,{CLEAR}但论长相也就那样吧,普普通通,{CLEAR}还没有我们桧皮镇的阿笔馆主可爱呢。
strings.en: Oh, that {VAR:0103:0} kid is just too{NEWLINE}low-key. Hardly any merch! From{CLEAR}what I’ve seen of the Indigo{CLEAR}Conference recordings, sure, he’s{CLEAR}the strongest, but his looks are just{CLEAR}so-so. Totally ordinary. Not even{CLEAR}as cute as our Bugsy here in Azalea!

strings.zh: 那你觉得联盟冠军漂亮吗？

strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: So, do you think League{NEWLINE}Champion {VAR:0101:0} is pretty?

strings.zh: 哎呀,大妈我只喜欢帅气的男训练家,{NEWLINE}女训练家我是不关注的啦。{CLEAR}不过就我看石英大会的录像来说,{CLEAR}这个联盟冠军{VAR:0101:0}虽说实力很强,{CLEAR}但这种霸气野丫头的类型{CLEAR}估计没什么人喜欢吧。
strings.en: Oh, this auntie only likes handsome{NEWLINE}male Trainers. I don’t follow the{CLEAR}girls. But from what I’ve seen of{CLEAR}the Indigo Conference recordings,{CLEAR}this League Champion {VAR:0101:0}{CLEAR}may be strong, but I doubt many{CLEAR}people like that bossy tomboy type.
